newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower as bear run continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower as bear run continues.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower on Tuesday on continued budget scepticism, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index dropped 11.76 points or 1.04 percent at 1,111.49 on a turnover of 53.8 million taka. Losers led gainers by 86 to 37 with three unchanged.
Brokers said selling pressure rose also because investors were under pressure from banks to pay back loans before the close of the fianancial year on June 30.
Singer Bangladesh slipped 138 taka to 5,996, Amam Sea Food lost 34 to 4,005 and General Insurance was up 12 to 471.
